title: ChangeList
description: A list of changes for one Revit model, in flo2-rvt's fixed vocabulary. The agent writes only this data; one reviewed add-in maps each change kind to the Revit API. Version 0 defines the envelope, the element reference and the first three change kinds. The schema accepts them, but no edit job runs them in v0: the only job is the read-only probe.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

version.description: The change-list format version. A new change kind or field that an older add-in could not read bumps it.

list_id.description: An optional id the author gives the list, echoed in the job's report.

description.description: What the list is for, in a sentence or two.

IfcGlobalId.description: An IFC GlobalId: 22 characters of IFC's base-64 alphabet, as Revit's own IFC exporter writes it for the element.

GlobalIdReference.description: An element named by its IFC GlobalId.

LevelNameReference.description: A level named by its name in the Revit model, matched exactly.

LevelReference.description: A level, named either by its name or by the GlobalId of the IfcBuildingStorey Revit exports for it.

Length.description: A length with its unit. The add-in converts it to Revit's internal feet.

ChangeId.description: An optional id for one change, echoed in the job's report next to what Revit did with it.

DeleteElementsOnLevel.description: Delete every model element hosted on, or associated with, the level. The level itself is kept.

DeleteElementsByGlobalId.description: Delete the elements named by their IFC GlobalIds.

SetLevelElevation.description: Set a level's elevation. Hosted elements follow their level, as they do in Revit.

relative_to.description: What the elevation is measured from: the project origin (Revit's ProjectElevation), or the level's own Elevation Base setting (Revit's Elevation).

Change.description: One change, distinguished by its kind.
